lines.en: That’s okay, though. Because we decide to head over to Sara’s place so I can drink away the pain — a method I’m sure Sara herself would endorse if she weren’t too busy taking inventory at the moment.
It feels a little weird being alone here with Osako when I found out along the way that the rest of our normal group is hanging out at our normal bar tonight.
I guess it’s harder for her to try and be herself when there’s a magnet inside of her too though. She’d just drift back to Wakana if given the opportunity.
And I imagine Wakana knows this as well since she seems to support this little outing if what my new partner in witchcraft is saying is true.

But hey, it’s not like we need to be with them in the first place. We can make our own decisions. And it’s way easier to talk without Rika getting riled up about trivia or Imani trying to fuck me in the bathroom.
The only question is what will we talk about now that our moment for exploration has come and gone?
Do we sit here and pretend that it was a success? That she’s closer to comfortable with herself now?
Or do we treat it like it is — one more failure in a list that I’m sure will be full of them before she can find what makes her happy.
: So, that was a total failure.
Okay. Good. At least she isn’t indecisive enough to not decide for me.
: For what it’s worth, you never struck me as a witchcraft person anyway. Just the type who fucks them.
: At least I know where to go girlfriend hunting if Wakana ever does break up with me.
: She would have done that already if you two weren’t meant to be together.
: Oh, shut it. Nobody is meant to be with anyone. The two of us can fail just as easy as anybody else. Probably easier now that you and I are off on our own while they get drunk and talk about us.
: What do you think they’re saying?
: I don’t know. Hasn’t really crossed my mind.
: You expect me to believe that a girl who is chronically worried about her place in this world just hasn’t put any thought into what her significant other is saying about her behind her back?
: Maybe I’ve just been having so much fun with you that it’s distracting me from all the worrying?
: You’re dying inside, aren’t you?
: Hah! It probably seems that way if I’ve resorted to taking night classes, huh?
: And, you know...maybe it’s true to a certain extent. I mean...it’s obviously true to a certain extent.

: But for the first time in my life, it isn’t really about Wakana. Or love. Or...security or stability or any of that other stuff I’ve been getting buried by since college. It’s about me. And that’s...great.

: I kind of like this feeling. Failure. Trying things out and then looking back on them and thinking it was funny I ever expected it to work in the first place. That’s not a thing I’ve ever felt before.
: It’s like what I was saying to your little sister earlier. I had plenty of friends when I was younger. I did really well in all of my clubs.

: And, while my family is nowhere near as wealthy as Wakana’s, they’ve always been supportive of me. So if I ever did fail at anything, which I can’t really remember, I’m sure they would have helped me through it.
: Sorry, are you just bragging now?
: Maybe a little. Why? Does that strike a nerve as someone who fails at everything all the time?
: You know I’m just kidding, right?
: Yeah...I know. I just wish I was able to handle it as well as you do.
: Maybe once you get used to failing at everything, though, you’ll start feeling a little differently about it.
: Akira.
: You’re not a failure.
: You’re really not.
: Osako-
: I talked to Imani the other day.
: Okay. But being good at sex isn’t enough to make me not a-
: Not about that, idiot. Though, it definitely did come up and I definitely do know way too much about your penis now.
: It was only a matter of time...
: I’m talking about that thing you two talked about.
: You do know that...walking away from something because it’s what’s best for you doesn’t make you a failure, right?
: It does when it’s your responsibility. You’d think the same thing about yourself if you had to leave the dojo.
: If I had to choose between my own personal happiness and the dojo, I’d choose myself every time. I’m not going to suffer just because it’s “the right thing to do.” And you shouldn’t either.
: I’m assuming Wakana doesn’t know yet?
: What makes you think that?
: The fact that she hasn’t come for my head.
: Pfft.
: Yeah, okay. Fair.
: Do you really think she’d get mad at you over something like that, though? If she knew it was something you needed to do to feel human again?
: The word “again” implies that I have ever felt human at all.
: Haven’t you?
: Those practice fights with Ayane...those nights at the dive bar, kicking all of our asses at trivia with Rika...
: That time we went down on our partners together?! Surely you must have felt human in those moments, right?
: Do you need another drink? I’ll buy the next one.
: This is kind of hard for me.
: Akira, I know you're attracted to me. But it just isn’t going to happen.
: Not that. This...bonding thing. Having to open up to someone without envisioning what choices and words will lead to sex the quickest.
: You don’t have to open up. We can just drink.
: I kind of want to, though. I just don’t know how.
: Then...is that really how you look at everyone? Is every conversation just a means of getting a girl’s pants off?
: Maybe not all of them...but enough for it to be unhealthy.
: Especially when you remember who I’m talking to.
: Any amount is unhealthy when you take that into consideration. So walking away from school wouldn’t just be what’s best for me, it’d be what’s best for everyone.
: Despite all that, though...I still can’t bring myself to do it.
: Why?
: Akira...
: Are you sure you want to admit this to me? Because I’m not saying you’re about to admit anything...but I do know what you’re implying. And I want to stop you before you say something you’ll regret.
: I don’t know, Osako.
: I have no idea.
: Hah...
: I can’t even pretend to understand what you’re going through right now. And that sucks. It really does.
: Like...I want to help, but...what can someone even do to help with a problem like that?
: At least you see it as a problem. That’s more than most are able to offer up.
: Sure. But, like you said a second ago, most of the people you’re dealing with aren’t...smart enough yet to make their own decisions.
: No one our age knows. Wakana doesn’t know. Imani doesn’t know. Rika doesn’t know. So now I have to be the one who knows. And I don’t know what to do about it.
: I’m sorry I’ve burdened you with the knowledge of who I really am, Osako.
: You should be...
: Why’d you have to go and make me care about you?...
: Life was so much easier when you were just some asshole-ish creepy guy flirting with the rich girl at my karate class. I wasn’t ever supposed to care.
: So why do you?...

: What was it about the way I act...how I constantly annoy you and flirt with you despite you hating it and...how I unintentionally make your girlfriend ignore you for my sake that made you like me? I don’t get it.
: And you think I do?
: Until recently, I was fine with you just being a step or two above an acquaintance. But...
: You seem different when it’s just us. Better. Real.
: The flirting and shit doesn’t bother me. I fuck with you too. It’s just...frustrating doing all this stuff to try and “find myself” beside someone who’s decided it’s okay to just stay lost.
: It makes me feel like you’re only helping at all because it gives you one more excuse to not do the same yourself. And that pisses me off...
: I pity you, Akira. I pity the type of mind that can see what needs to be done to enact the changes you need and just...not even make an attempt to do the same.
: Getting a new hobby won’t stop me from preying on teenagers, Osako.
: And there it is...
: I’m both proud of you and hate you for admitting that at the same time.
: Because you have to deal with it now too?
: Yeah.
: Do I side with my morals and do what’s right? Do I ruin a friend’s life and, by extension, ruin a bunch of other lives in the process? It’s not exactly an easy choice.
: You wouldn’t be ruining anything — just making a handful of people very upset for a sizable amount of time.
: But then a girl would lose her father a second time. My partner would lose her best friend. My other friend would lose the man she’s rapidly falling for.
: But, worst of all, I’d lose my witchcraft buddy!
: I’m surprised you can still make jokes after hearing what I just confessed to.
: I had a thousand red flags to soften the blow. I’d just hoped it would never be something that became so real.
: But if you figured it out so easily, what’s stopping Wakana and Imani from doing the same?
: Easy. They like you more, so they’re giving you every benefit of every doubt that has ever existed.
: And how do you think they’d feel if they found out?
: Crushed. Both of them. Then they’d probably feel like failures too for looking straight past all of the signs you posted around them pointing directly to this.
: I really am just fucking up everything then, huh?
: You sure are. Way to ruin the night, asshole.
: I bet you feel better about yourself now though, right?
: Yeah. I feel really great buying drinks for a predator. You got me there.
: Anyway...I think I am going to quit.
: Everything just...makes more sense that way. And yeah, it’d make more sense if I stopped seeking the girls out entirely, but...
: They’re important to you...and that’s okay. It’s everything else you’re doing that’s not.
: Yeah...
: Thank you for not using your karate to chop me in half.
: Don’t mention it. Feel any better after getting that off your chest? Do you want to choose the next night class?
: No. I just want to not hate myself for a minute. That would be enough.
: Guess we’ll just have to keep looking then. Maybe we’ll find something we can both enjoy?
: Well, I’ve always wanted to try banging Wakana-
: Actually, maybe I will chop you in half? It’ll cut down some of the calories I gained from drinking tonight and the world will be a safer place. The pros really do outweigh the cons here.
: I have never agreed with anyone so much.
: Um...uh...Sensei?...
: Oh. Hey, Sana. I didn’t realize you were working tonight.
: Yuki is...not here again and...actually, that doesn’t matter right now...
: Can we talk?...
: About what?
: Just...something you said the other day...
: I...I realize I...
: Uhh...I realized my...reaction...wasn’t really...uhh...
: Don’t worry about it. I was just being dumb.
: Just...being...dumb?...
: Yeah. It’s nothing you need to be worried about.
: Can you grab us two more beers, though? I’m going to need them.
: Why?
: To...drink?
: ...Sana?
: It’s nothing.
: I’ll be right back with your order...
Osako and I talk for another hour or so before we decide to head out.
Things get less serious, thankfully. Though, I probably shouldn’t be too thankful when it was me who made things serious in the first place.
Am I glad that I essentially admitted to her what I’ve been doing? Nope. In fact, I feel ten times worse.
But...
I think I get what she was saying about failure feeling good now, though.
And I think the fact that I feel this shameful at all is indicative of something bigger.
I really like being with her.
But all good things must come to an end. And for tomorrow to ever begin, we must first bid farewell to today.
Perhaps what comes when the sun shines again won’t make me feel like I’ve lived in the dark all these years.
I just know that, whatever happens next, I must feel like a failure to ever know what it means to succeed.
I hope she finds her happiness first — for she is far more deserving than a cretin like me.
: Are you gonna be okay?
: Yeah...I just need to get my head straight.
: No. I mean are you going to be okay walking home? You don’t need me to be your bodyguard?

: Oh. Come to think of it, I would feel a little more comfortable if you were to just stay in my room with me tonight. Fight off any demons that come to claim me. You might have to sign an NDA, though.
: Meh. I think I’ll just let you be claimed by the demons. It was nice knowing you, though.
: Yeah. Nice knowing you too, Osako.
: Guess I’ll just...see you when I see you then.
: I’ll send you the class list. I’m serious about letting you choose the next one.
: Osako-
: This doesn’t have to just be for me anymore. We can figure shit out together.
: And if you ever need to talk, you know where I live.
: Wakana is going to be so jealous of how close we’re getting.
: Maybe she’ll finally know how I felt then!
: What?
: Night, Akira! Don’t do anything stupid! Like...seriously! You do some really stupid shit!
: Goodnight, Osako. Have fun banging my future girlfriend.
I don’t get a snarky response this time.
Just more indecision and the unwelcome recollection of another strange night when I turn around to head home.
: Nao-chan! Grabbing more than three wiggleworms at once will confuse the Frog Boy! You must move slowly! Only one at a time!
I took her first time and have barely looked at her since.
But was it really her at all?
: Ah! The hot bean water! I forgot to empty its mesh-bed! Wait right there, Nao-chan! I will return in seventeen seconds!
Why hasn’t she come to see me?
Is she scared?
She doesn’t sound scared.
She doesn’t sound any different at all.
She probably doesn’t even realize what happened.
: Nao-chan, is something not right? What has drawn your attention so late in the night?
I’m gone before I hear Kaori say anything else.
One more word and I would have kicked down the door.
Osako’s affection has increased to [osako_love]!
